notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the edge strip (ground colour) and edge + black border, as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet W6-SA110 (see the DIT supplement to AS 1742.10; W6-9 is the yellow version): W6-SA110A illustrated (B 750). Diamond 600 side, drawn in its 848.53 bounding square (centre 424.26); fluorescent yellow-green, R40, 10 / 30 (edge 10 + border 20). Symbol: pedestrian (250 high) above a bicycle (200 high), as AS 1743 W6-9 — taken from the sheet's own filled artwork (PDF fills rendered at 1000 dpi without the dimension and centre lines, traced), ink box x 272-577, y 122-625 as drawn on the sign.
